redfin.remarks: Welcome to 24150 Western Avenue! Beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath, ground-level condo offering single-level living with no stairs. Located in a secure gated community , the home features a private patio , dining room, two-car garage, new A/C and furnace, stainless-steel kitchen appliances, new dishwasher, abundant cabinetry and storage, and an in-unit washer and dryer. The primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and ensuite bathroom. Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds maintained by gardeners twice a week, plus a community pool and paddleball tennis court . Conveniently located near the 405 and 110 freeways, approximately 11 miles to LAX and less than 5 miles to Torrance Beach. Close to restaurants, shopping, the renowned Del Amo Fashion Center, and nearby schools. An excellent opportunity to enjoy comfortable South Bay living in a convenient location.
